pages.text: Nests are lumps riddled with holes, with something always stirring inside. While you're within 16 blocks, a nest lets out 1 or 2 of its meteor's bugs every 10 to 25 seconds, until 6 are around it. Break a nest to stop it. They drop a good amount of experience.
pages.title: Nests

pages.text: Swamp: Bogspinners, Glasswings, Bloodgnats and Reedmantises.
pages.title: Mire Nest

pages.text: Hive: Combwasps, Stingers, Propolis Spitters, Honeyguards and Waxmites.
pages.title: Brood Comb

pages.text: Desert: Tomb Scorpions, Sanddivers, Shieldbacks and Antlions.
pages.title: Sand Burrow

pages.text: Rainforest: Pouncers, Canopy Assassins, Twigwalkers, Bloommantises and Lantern Moths.
pages.title: Rotwood Hollow
